reason: No RANS-SA force integration was run, so no component factor was computed and none was written into an assembly. Q and FF were not revised.

case.geometry: NACA Report 540 combination 7, half model, same stations as examples/validation/avl_bodies/tr540_c07_mid.json
case.citation: Eastman N. Jacobs and Kenneth E. Ward, NACA Report No. 540, 1936
case.flow: Mach 0.15, Re_chord 3.1e6, the buildup point. Alpha 0 is the CD0 point (symmetric section, CL about 0).
case.surface: Smooth OpenCASCADE loft. Nose and tail stations that are points in the table are closed with a 0.3 mm radius. That radius is a CAD closure, not a change to the station table.

buildup.source: acdt cd0_buildup defaults: surface laminar fraction 0.10, body 0, smooth_paint. rho chosen so Re_chord = 3.1e6 at Mach 0.15.
buildup.denominator: A factor would be D/q_CFD divided by f_m2 (friction*Q + upsweep + base), before the leakage and protuberance markup. The total CD0 band includes that markup.

mesh.tool: Gmsh 4.15.2, 2026-03-24, Windows, called as gmsh.exe. The Gmsh Python API was not imported.

why_not_a_calibration: Gmsh 4.15.2 documents the BoundaryLayer field as a 2D constraint (manual: insert a 2D boundary layer next to curves). Field[3].FacesList is an unknown option on that field. Confirmed on this binary.
Extrude { Surface{...}; Layers{...}; } on the OpenCASCADE model stops with: Boundary layer extrusion not available with OpenCASCADE geometry kernel.

ClassifySurfaces + CreateGeometry + Extrude, then gmsh -3, wrote 500 nodes and 2472 tetrahedra and 0 prisms. The -3 pass remeshes extruded volumes with the tetrahedral algorithm. A rerun without -3 did not advance (the process stayed idle and was stopped).

At Re_chord = 3.1e6 and the buildup density, a y+ of about 1 is a first cell near 1e-6 m. The isotropic mesh spacing is 0.008 m. Spalart-Allmaras integrated to the wall on that mesh is not a calibration of the buildup. Three such levels would not be a Richardson study of the viscous drag.
OpenVSP is not installed on this Windows host. The image does contain an OpenVSP tree, but SU2 for this run is the Windows OpenMP build. A smooth OML was built in Gmsh instead of a faceted STEP.
